title: IsTrap (spell flag)
html:
IsTrap is a spell flag which indicates whether an action is considered a trap. This flag is checked by  Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps. Characters with Dungeon Delver will have  Advantage on  Saving Throws and take half damage (which stacks with any resistances) from any actions with this flag.

In addition to the actions listed below, there are trap versions of many normal spells such as  Fireball that are used for various traps.
